body:
Yeh, there are number of inconsistencies, especially when it comes to System.register bundles. This bundle list was growing "organically" and don't share the same config / build pipeline.

Will work through this list, but there are a couple of items that need discussion:

> angular2.umd.js and angular2.js are not equal when it comes to content, why make the name look like they differ only in format?

How about `angular2-all.umd.js` ?

> angular2-testing.umd.dev.js is prefixed with angular2- but testing.js is not

So `angular2-testing.umd.dev.js` contains angular2-all _plus_ testing, while `testing.js` has only testing stuff without anything from ng2 core (System.register bundles are additive, UMD are not)

So, if we put WebWorker aside for now, we are left with those items:
- [ ] `angular2.umd.js` and `angular2.js` are not equal when it comes to content, why make the name look like they differ only in format?
- [ ] `angular2-testing.umd.dev.js` is prefixed with `angular2-` but `testing.js` is not
- [ ] some bundles have `dev` variant, others don't - seems a bit random

Let me tackle those one-by-one below.

> `angular2.umd.js` and `angular2.js` are not equal when it comes to content, why make the name look like they differ only in format?

True, `angular2.umd.js` has much more barrels. How about `angular2-all.umd.js`?

> angular2-testing.umd.dev.js is prefixed with angular2- but testing.js is not

Right. So `angular2-` prefix is there since UMD bundle contains angular2 _all_ and testing. If we go with the previous item the only name I can think of would be `angular2-all-testing.umd.js`

> some bundles have dev variant, others don't - seems a bit random

So, the only bundles that don't have dev variant (putting WebWorkers aside) are:
- `angular2-polyfills.js` - here dev / prod doesn't come into play as we are not bundling ng2 code here
-  `testing.js` -> actually this one should be `testing.dev.js` IMO

So the actionable item here could be: rename testing.js -> testing.dev.js

As a summary, here is a proposal for actionable items. Rename:
- `angular2.umd.js` -> `angular2-all.umd.js`
- `angular2-testing.umd.js` -> `angular2-all-testing.umd.js`
- `testing.js` -> `testing.dev.js`

How does it sound?

issue.title: fix(bundles): rename UMD bundles
